profit_quality.assessment: Main denominator uses a conservative distributable cash profit rather than reported net profit. The three-year adjusted attributable profit median is RMB68.249m, but 2023 and 2024 operating cash flows were negative, because customer receivables and contract assets consumed large cash while bank borrowings funded working capital. After deducting RMB9.13m maintenance-like capex and RMB40m normalized working-capital reinvestment, pre-haircut distributable cash profit is RMB19.119m; applying a 0.50 cash-profit haircut gives RMB9.5595m.
adjustments: Did not use 2024 reported attributable loss of RMB70.970m as the sole denominator because it includes RMB130.945m goodwill impairment.
Used the 2022-2024 median adjusted profit attributable to equity holders, RMB68.249m, as the normal profit starting point.
Deducted RMB9.13m for capex, using 2024 purchases of property, plant and equipment plus intangible assets.
Deducted RMB40m normalized working-capital reinvestment because the business grants 90-150 day credit to some customers and receivables/contract assets expanded materially.
Applied a 0.50 profit haircut because operating cash flow was RMB-151.887m in 2023 and RMB-105.999m in 2024.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2024 operating cash flow was RMB-105.999m; 2023 operating cash flow was RMB-151.887m. In 2024, trade receivables, contract assets and notes receivables consumed RMB447.889m of working capital.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Long-term cash conversion is poor in the extracted years; profit growth is tied to receivables and working-capital funding.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Weak: 2024 operating cash flow divided by adjusted profit attributable to equity holders was about -1.21x.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: 2024 capex was low at RMB9.13m, mainly decoration, computer equipment, furniture and software.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: High reinvestment need: receivables and contract assets rose with digital technology and cloud services; turnover days increased to 102 days.
